programme.title: Dynasties II
programme.desc: The authors present the fate of wild animals that, living in often difficult conditions, persistently fight for the survival of their families.Each episode concerns a representative of a different species and members of its herd.Viewers will learn, among others:the story of the eight-year-old cheetah Kali, a resident of the grassy plains in western Zambia.Despite her relatively old age, the female desperately protects her family, teaching her daughters to be independent.A resident of Kenya, an inexperienced elephant, tries to secure the existence of her twins and unite the herd after the death of the leader.A puma from Patagonia takes care of four cubs alone.The program also features croquets, whose females are fighting an internal fight for dominance, as well as a young meerkat queen and Mac the macaque, trying to maintain his dominant role in the herd and father an offspring, thus initiating his own monkey dynasty.

programme.desc: BAFTA-winning actor Bill Nighy, known for, among others,from the film "Love Actually", invites viewers to another series of railway journeys through picturesque corners of the world.The New Zealand route starts in Greymouth and goes through Arthur's Pass National Park, Cass, the Waimakiriri Gorge and Christchurch.Bill also discovers the charms of Taiwan and Norwegian landscapes from the train windows on the distance from Bergen to Oslo.Viewers will also take an exciting trip on the Austrian Transalpine Railway, which crosses the snow-capped peaks of Tyrol.

programme.title: Solar System
programme.desc: The host of the program, Professor Brian Cox, presents selected information about the solar system.Viewers will learn about planets and moons covered with volcanoes that erupt with fire and ice.In the following parts, the scientist talks about the most interesting atmospheric conditions that were noticed on celestial bodies neighboring the Earth.He visits landscapes created by dust whirls, mountains covered with metallic frost and monsoon rains on one of the moons.Additionally, Professor Cox will introduce viewers to frozen regions of the solar system, including a dwarf planet with mountains of solid ice floating on it, as well as a black and white moon.
